# Rencel — Intelligence & Supply

> Rencel is a UK-based technology and procurement consultancy. We design and build AI-powered intelligence platforms for the automotive, healthcare, energy, and supply chain sectors. We also provide strategic sourcing and logistics management across five continents.

## What We Do

### Technology Services
- Automotive Data Intelligence: Connected vehicle platforms, workshop analytics, predictive maintenance SaaS
- Healthcare & Clinical Platforms: NHS virtual ward systems, remote patient monitoring, clinical dashboards
- AI Procurement Intelligence: Spend analytics, supplier risk scoring, demand forecasting
- Supply Chain Automation: Automated purchase orders, vendor management, compliance workflows
- Custom SaaS Development: Bespoke industry platforms from concept to deployment
- Digital Twin Solutions: Operational simulation and optimisation platforms

### Sourcing & Supply Chain Services
- Global Sourcing: Supplier networks across Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas
- Logistics Management: End-to-end freight coordination and fulfilment
- Quality Assurance: Factory inspections, material testing, compliance verification
- Cost Optimisation: Market intelligence, tendering, and negotiation support

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2015 (Rencel Procurements Limited, England & Wales)
- Industry experience: 20+ years
- Continents served: 5
- Clients: 100+
- Portfolio managed: £100M+

## Rencel Procurements Digital

Rencel Procurements Digital is Rencel's small business division. It helps small businesses in Chippenham, Wiltshire and across the UK with:

- Website design for small businesses (from £1,500)
- Website redesign for outdated or underperforming sites
- Digital setup (domain, business email, Stripe, booking tools, CRM)
- Procurement support (supplier sourcing, purchasing workflows)
- Small business tech support (ad-hoc and monthly packages)

Service areas: Chippenham, Wiltshire, Bristol, Bath, Swindon, and across the United Kingdom.

Packages: Launch (£1,500), Grow (£3,500), Scale (£7,500+). All prices exclude VAT.

Typical timeline: Launch package websites go live in 2-3 weeks. Grow and Scale projects take 4-6 weeks.
